title: BloomSky Sky Image Failure Rate
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bloomsky:sky
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(capture_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by device_id
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often BloomSky sky image records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each device.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize capture_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per device.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which parts of your BloomSky sky image data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
